info.name: Etamid Admin API
info.description:
# Etamid (اعتمد) Admin API — Cycle 9

Admin routes only, under `/admin/api` plus the frozen operator points under `/api/v1/admin`.
Separate from the app API (`Etamid API` collection) and from `docs/etamid-openapi.yaml`.

## Quick Start

1. Run **Auth & 2FA / Authentication / Login** with the super-admin email and password.
2. If 2FA is on, run **2FA Verify** with the 6-digit code from Google Authenticator (tokens are saved automatically).
3. If 2FA is not set up yet, Login returns `twoFactorSetupRequired` plus a `challengeToken` — run **Two-Factor Setup / Setup-Challenge**, add the secret to Google Authenticator, then **Enable-Challenge**.

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. This is pre-configured at the collection level. Public endpoints use **No Auth**.

Admin tokens use a separate **AdminJwt** scheme (issuer `etamid-admin`, 15 minutes, claims `sub` / `type=admin` / `sid` / `jti`, no permissions inside the token). App-user tokens are rejected with 401 here, and admin tokens are rejected with 401 on `/api/v1`.

## Response Envelope

Every response follows:

``` json
{ "success": true, "message": string, "data": object|array|null }
```

`errors` appears **only** on failed responses, and `meta` **only** on paginated lists. Paginated lists add:

``` json
"meta": { "page": 1, "pageSize": 20, "total": 42, "totalPages": 3 }
```

**Admin responses are always HTTP 200 when the request reached the server** (Cycle 9, `a2eff0a`). Check `body.success` and `errors[0].code`, not the status code. Rate limiting still returns 429 at the middleware level.

## Validation & Business Errors

Every error has a **stable** **`code`** (used by the app logic) and a localized `message` (shown to the user):

``` json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Invalid credentials.",
  "data": null,
  "errors": [ { "code": "ADMIN_INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "message": "Invalid credentials." } ]
}
```

Common codes: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden (`ADMIN_FORBIDDEN`), `404` not found, `409` conflict (for example `USER_HAS_ACTIVE_DEALS`), `422` validation, `429` rate limit (`Retry-After` header) or account locked.

## Conventions

- **Language:** send `Accept-Language: ar | en` (variable `language`).
- **Dates:** ISO 8601 UTC. **Money:** SAR numbers with two decimals.
- **Pagination:** `page` (default 1) and `pageSize` (default 20, max 100).
- **Permissions:** checked per request from the database, never from the token. `GET /admin/api/auth/me` returns the current admin with roles and permissions.
- **2FA is mandatory** for every admin. Self-disable returns 403; the only recovery is a super-admin reset (`POST /admin/api/admins/{id}/reset-2fa`).
- **Rate limit:** 10/min per IP on auth endpoints. 5 failed logins lock the account for 15 minutes.
- **Admin tokens:** access 15 minutes, refresh 30 days (rotating). Reusing a rotated refresh token ends ALL sessions of that admin.

exec: pm.test('Status is a documented response (200, 401, 429)', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description:
## Sign In (Password Step)

**Public endpoint — no authentication required.**

First step of the admin login. Returns a 5-minute single-use 2FA challenge when 2FA is enabled or not yet set up — tokens are issued only after the 2FA step.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| email | string | ✅ | Admin email |
| password | string | ✅ | Admin password (12–64 chars) |

### Business Rules
- Unknown email and wrong password look identical (`ADMIN_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`).
- 5 failures lock the account for 15 minutes.
- `twoFactorRequired: true` → run **2FA Verify** with the challenge.
- `twoFactorSetupRequired: true` → run **Two-Factor Setup / Setup-Challenge**, then **Enable-Challenge**.
- 2FA is mandatory for every admin.

### Next Step
The test script saves `challengeToken` automatically. Call `POST /admin/api/auth/2fa/verify` (2FA on) or the setup-challenge flow (2FA off).

### Frontend Notes
- On `twoFactorRequired` show the 6-digit TOTP screen.
- On `twoFactorSetupRequired` route to `/login/2fa-setup`.
- Never reveal whether the email exists.

response.name: 200 OK — 2FA Required

request.description:
## Verify 2FA Code

**Public endpoint — no authentication required.**

Exchange the login challenge plus a TOTP code (30 s step, +/-1 drift) for tokens.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| challengeToken | string | ✅ | From Login |
| code | string | ✅ | 6-digit TOTP from Google Authenticator |

### Business Rules
- A wrong code issues nothing and counts toward lockout.
- The challenge is single-use and expires in 5 minutes.

### Next Step
Tokens are saved automatically by the test script.

### Frontend Notes
- Show the remaining attempts on a wrong code; lockout is 15 minutes after 5 failures.

request.description:
## Refresh Token

**Public endpoint — no authentication required.**

Rotate the refresh token (30 days) and get a new access token (15 minutes).

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| refreshToken | string | ✅ | Current refresh token |

### Business Rules
- Reusing a rotated token ends ALL admin sessions of that admin (`ADMIN_REFRESH_REUSED`).

### Next Step
Tokens are saved automatically by the test script.

### Frontend Notes
- The admin interceptor refreshes once on `TOKEN_EXPIRED` / `TOKEN_INVALID`, then retries the request once.

**Requires authentication.**

### Business Rules

### Frontend Notes
- Use this to drive the sidebar and per-route permission checks; never decode the token.

request.description:
## 2FA Setup — Step 1 (Anonymous)

**Public endpoint — no authentication required.**

Mandatory-2FA setup step 1. Exchange the login setup-challenge for a TOTP secret (stored encrypted, inactive until enabled). Does not consume the challenge.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| challengeToken | string | ✅ | From a Login that returned `twoFactorSetupRequired` |

### Next Step
Add the returned `secret` to Google Authenticator (or open `otpAuthUri`), then call **Enable-Challenge** with a current code.

### Frontend Notes
- Show the secret and the QR code from `otpAuthUri` on the `/login/2fa-setup` page.

**Public endpoint — no authentication required.**

### Business Rules
- A wrong code issues nothing and counts toward lockout.
- Calling setup-challenge again overwrites the stored secret.

### Next Step
Tokens are saved automatically by the test script.

request.description:
## Generate TOTP Secret (Logged In)

**Requires authentication.**

Generate a TOTP secret (stored encrypted, inactive until enabled). Returns the Base32 secret and an otpauth URI.

### Business Rules
- Returns 409 `ADMIN_2FA_ALREADY_ENABLED` when 2FA is already on.
- Prefer the anonymous setup-challenge flow for admins who have not set up 2FA yet.

- The new admin must complete mandatory 2FA setup on first login.

request.description:
## Execute Agreement

**Requires authentication.** Needs `admin.disputes.decide`. Execute what the buyer and the seller agreed between themselves — the admin never decides a dispute. The money moves in the same request.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| resolution | string | ✅ | `ReleaseSeller` \| `RefundBuyer` \| `Partial` — what the parties agreed |
| sellerPercent | integer | — | Required for `Partial` (1–99) — the agreed seller share |
| note | string | ✅ | Record of the parties' agreement |

### Business Rules
- Fills `ResolvedByAdminId`. Audit action `admin.dispute.execute_agreement`.
- The agreement is final: executing a second agreement returns `AlreadyResolved`.
- Change `resolution` to `RefundBuyer` to refund the buyer, or to `Partial` with `sellerPercent` (e.g. 60) to split as agreed.

### Frontend Notes
- Confirm before calling — the money moves immediately and cannot be undone.

response.name: 200 OK — Release to Seller

request.description:
## Send Dispute Documents

**Requires authentication.** Needs `admin.disputes.decide`. Send the dispute documents to the buyer so the buyer can take the case to court — used when the buyer and the seller could not agree.

Upload the files first with **Upload Dispute File** (it saves `disputeFileId`), then send their ids here.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| filePublicIds | string[] | ✅ | 1–5 ids of files uploaded with Upload Dispute File |

### Business Rules
- Moves no money and changes no status: the dispute stays open and the escrow stays frozen.
- Adds an admin message with the files and no text (no sentence, no note) and notifies the buyer only. Audit action `admin.dispute.send_documents`.

request.description:
## Post Dispute Message

**Requires authentication.** Needs `admin.disputes.decide`. Post a message in the dispute thread as the admin.

### Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| message | string | ✅ | The message text (max 1000) |
| isInternalNote | boolean | — | `true` = admins only, no notification. Default `false` = visible to both parties |

### Business Rules
- A visible message notifies both the buyer and the seller; an internal note notifies nobody. Audit action `admin.dispute.message`.
- The dispute must be open — posting on a closed dispute returns `InvalidState`.
- Returns **201 Created** with the created message.
